mapper.insert: insert into tbl_member (member_email, member_phone, member_password, member_name, member_alias, member_bio) values (#{memberEmail}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberPassword}, #{memberName}, #{memberAlias}, #{memberBio})
mapper.select: select m.id, m.member_email, m.member_phone, m.member_password, m.member_name, m.member_alias, m.member_bio, m.member_status, m.member_login_verified, a.member_role, m.created_datetime, m.updated_datetime from tbl_member m left join tbl_auth a on a.id = m.id where m.id = #{id}

select m.id, m.member_email, m.member_phone, m.member_password, m.member_name, m.member_alias, m.member_bio, m.member_status, m.member_login_verified, a.member_role, m.created_datetime, m.updated_datetime from tbl_member m left join tbl_auth a on a.id = m.id where (m.member_email = #{loginId} or m.member_phone = #{loginId}) and m.member_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update tbl_member set member_password = #{memberPassword}, updated_datetime = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from tbl_member where member_alias = #{alias}
mapper.update: update tbl_member set member_alias = #{alias}, member_bio = #{bio}, updated_datetime = now() where id = #{id}
